allow_large: Unavailable capability reasons not derived from the real mount decision: every place it appears; no interface change. Most counted files are inherited from the unmerged #605 this fix builds on
done_when: Each unavailable capability's reason in the run's instructions is derived from the runner's real mount decision (for example the browser IPC credential, not the Browser grant), and the boundary test checks every unavailable reason, not only delegation's

findings.body: In a full-preset run with authority hiding enabled, unselected admin tools receive `tools are hidden for this run`, although hiding does not prevent their mounting: selected admin tools are restored at lines 180–182 and in `apps/core/src/runner/mcp/server.ts:196–199`. Their actual missing condition is selection. This affects settings_desired_state, request_settings_update, guided_action_preview, admin_permission_list, admin_permission_revoke, service_restart and register_agent whenever unselected, in both engines. New evidence beyond the ruling preserving selected admin tools is that the reason renderer does not respect that exception. The boundary oracle at `apps/core/test/unit/runtime/gantry-tools-in-run.test.ts:285` requires the same incorrect hidden reason, so its existing hidden-run scenario passes despite the defect. Preserve locked-preset reasons, but report missing selection for these admin capabilities in nonlocked runs and correct the boundary expectations.
findings.title: Not done: Each unavailable capability's reason in the run's instructions is derived from the runner's real mount decision

why: The agent's 'unavailable' reasons come from grants instead of what the runner really mounts
